svg.text: RobustLab | when floating-point boundary signs disagree
Exact rational audits of stored binary floats. L-infinity balls. Strict worst signed margin > 0.
Certificates use integer numerator/denominator comparisons, not the decimal views printed above.
Every exact attack is rational, feasible in the stated ball, and attains the exact worst margin.
Exact binary inputs are not exact decimal literals. Full fractions, models and witnesses are embedded.
Boundary fixtures were selected to expose rounding, not to estimate its frequency. The trained demo is unchanged.
L1 and L-infinity only. All-real coordinates, no clipping. This does not certify a separately rounded execution pipeline.
Independent implementation using standard norm duality and Python Fraction arithmetic.
